description: This Kotlin source file defines the ContentInfoActivity class for an Android TV application. It manages the UI for displaying detailed content information, including channel details, program title, metadata, and action buttons for interactions like play, schedule, record, etc. The class handles content population from intent extras, focus animations for D-pad navigation, and network requests to retrieve media URLs for playback. It also includes a factory method for creating intents to launch this activity with specific content data.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An activity that displays detailed information about a content item, including channel info, program metadata, and action buttons. Handles UI rendering, focus animations, and network interactions for media playback.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting up UI elements, populating data, and configuring action buttons.

methods.name: setupSystemDateTime
methods.description: Sets current system date and time in the UI.

methods.name: populateContentData
methods.description: Populates UI fields with content data received via intent extras, applying default values if no extras are provided.

methods.name: setupActionButtons
methods.description: Initializes action buttons, assigns icons, labels, focus, and click handlers.

methods.name: animateButtonFocus
methods.description: Animates UI changes when an action button gains or loses focus, including scale, translation, elevation, and label opacity.

methods.name: handleButtonAction
methods.description: Handles the logic when an action button is pressed, including visual feedback and invoking specific functions.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Overrides hardware key handling to enable D-pad navigation and button selection.

methods.name: handlePlay
methods.description: Invokes an API call to retrieve a media URL and launches the PlayerActivity to play the content. Includes fallback logic for errors.
